author: pep-react-lab-replacement author lane (Claude Opus 5.5)
decidedBy: pep-react-lab-replacement-reconciler loop 9 (Claude Opus 5.5, fresh independent context; neither the lab author, either critic, nor any earlier reconciler), applying Firstmate decision react-forms-y1-per-file option A

decisions.rationale: Status changed in loop 9: loop 8 decided escalate; the loop-9 education and SME rechecks mark it resolved and raise no new findings. This decision supersedes the loop-8 escalation. Decided: Firstmate decision react-forms-y1-per-file chose option A (every load-failing learner test file is an unreadable form and must receive the existing general unreadable message, regardless of whether another learner test file produced assertions; one bounded per-file condition in tests/verify-learner-test.mjs; no suite error exposed; the deleted-file no-runnable route and every other accepted or rejected oracle result preserved). Implemented at commit 7c689dd9; the diff df5f02b9..7c689dd9 under react/forms-context-and-crud touches only tests/verify-learner-test.mjs and the module lock. It adds one per-file loadFailed flag to runVariant (some test file has status failed and no passed or failed assertion in it) and replaces the load-failure branch's report-wide condition (a failed file, no failed assertion and zero passed) with loadFailed and no failed assertion anywhere; the no-runnable branch, the unreadable-form constant and every message text, the unchanged-copy branch and the variant scoring and unshift are unchanged. The verifier's sha256 is now 067ad8c03340ce5f3a6fe9ef2c01b2b534a2191d346367526eb71d3b227fa7b4; lab.json (5fa2f584...) and task8-variant.jsx (d85eae98...) are unchanged, so the recorded v1 and v3 lows are preserved. Reconciler-reproduced on macOS (darwin), Node 24.2.0 and npm 11.3.0, in a 0700 scratch copy made with git archive of 7c689dd9 (7c689dd91a046827623bbd8ebac64f2014c025d9), with the private overlay copied over the starter, npm ci in tests/ and TMPDIR pointed at a private scratch directory; the scratch directory was deleted afterwards. Load-failure guard used in the learner-side probe: a module-level check that throws a distinctive marker string only when the imported default export's source text contains a hook name used only by the Task 8 variant wrapper. (R) The overlay's reference test alone: 'Test Files 8 passed (8)', then the Task 8 accepted line, exit 0, before and after the probes. (C) The reference test unchanged plus a second learner test file holding the guard and one trivial passing test: normal run 'Test Files 9 passed (9)' and 'Tests 9 passed (9)', then exactly one Task 8 line, the general unreadable-form message, exit 1. (G) A module-level throw with a second marker string appended to a scratch copy of tests/task8-variant.jsx (restored afterwards, sha256 d85eae98... rechecked), the reference test unchanged, plus a second learner test file that does not import the form and holds one trivial passing test: normal run 9 of 9, then the same single unreadable-form line, exit 1. Loop 8 recorded the unchanged-copy message for both C and G under the earlier verifier, so 7c689dd9 is what moves them. Neither marker string, nor 'Vitest said', nor the unchanged-copy or no-runnable message appeared in C or G, so no suite error is exposed. (E) The README-named learner test file deleted ('Test Files 7 passed (7)'): only the no-runnable message, exit 1. The beforeAll-hook, afterAll, describe-scoped beforeAll, blank-only, name-only, missing not-called check and df5f02b9 verifier-swap cases are critic-reported and were not rerun by the reconciler. Accept-to-reject is impossible: a failed test file means the control run exited non-zero, so such a run was already rejected; only its message changes. Notes judged, not findings. (1) Masking: reconciler-reproduced with a trivial named test that only checks the import is a function. Alone it got all six scorable misses, exit 1; with the guarded second learner file added it got only the unreadable-form message, exit 1. This is not a real finding: nothing is accepted, the exit is 1 either way, the masking needs a learner file written to detect the check itself, and removing that file restores the scorable misses. Pre-existence is critic-reported for the blank-only shape (SME O1: the df5f02b9 verifier printed only the unchanged-copy message) and was not rerun by the reconciler; it follows from the earlier condition, under which a failed file beside a passed assertion elsewhere fell through to the unchanged-copy branch, which equally hid the scorable misses. (2) Control-only scope, code-read and SME-reported, not reconciler-reproduced: not a real finding. The control runs first and gates the variant loop, so any load failure that is not specific to one behaviour variant also fails the control, lands on the new branch and never reaches variant scoring. What remains is a file that loads under the control and fails to load only under one variant; there that variant's run has no failed assertion, so even a correct named test would get a false 'it still passes when...' line for that variant, exit 1, unchanged from before 7c689dd9. That is the same class of wrong message loop 8 escalated for G, but it needs a variant-specific cause (only the variant wrappers differ between control and variant runs), the decision's per-file condition is stated for the control run, and the outcome stays learner-safe: exit 1, nothing accepted, no suite error, no solution code. The reconciler did not construct such a cause. Byte-change verdict: no byte change is warranted; the implementation matches option A as written. No new finding ids are created. Consolidated with sme-fcc-y1.
